text:
sara: Heads-up — Canary mtls rotation in staging flagged intermittent handshakes in apac staging->prod mirror.
ben: saw that, any logs yet? :thinking_face:
carla: I pulled a few proxy logs, looks like `tlsv1.3` ClientHello, then a `certificate_unknown` from our edge for some clients.
sec-oncall: tagging KMS team — could be key access deny during signing? @ben did the rotator service assume role change land yesterday?
ben: yes, we updated rotator IAM to the new `rotator-service-role` at 03:12 UTC. Policy snippet: `{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:apac:...:key/abc"}` — same as prod. No denies in staging CloudTrail yet.
sara: the weird bit is only ~7% of connections error and they correlate to clients routed through apac-proxy-02.
carla: pasted tail of proxy stderr:
```
2026-03-20T03:45:12Z proxy[edge]: tls_handshake_error client=10.40.2.14 reason=certificate_unknown subject=CN=svc-client
2026-03-20T03:45:12Z proxy[edge]: crypto: invalid signature from keystore id=rotator:decrypt failed
```
ben: that `decrypt failed` is coming from the rotator calling KMS to unwrap the key. If KMS returns `AccessDenied`, the keystore returns a generic crypto error.
sec-oncall: can someone grep CloudTrail for `Decrypt` errors around 03:44-03:46 UTC for the apac key? I can check Audit Logs after.
sara: I ran a quick audit -> `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-20T03:40:00Z --end-time 2026-03-20T03:50:00Z` — found 5 `AccessDenied` entries from principal `rotator@staging` hitting apac-key.
carla: interesting — why only apac-proxy-02 then?
ben: apac-proxy-02 is on the older node image that still uses the legacy rotator binary (env `ROTATOR_VERSION=v1.8.2`). Newer nodes use v1.9 that caches session tickets differently. The legacy rotator retries less aggressively.
sara: so scenario: rotator role changed, some nodes' STS tokens expired and they couldn't assume updated role -> KMS denies -> handshake fails. We need to confirm STS expiration telemetry.
sec-oncall: check `kubectl -n infra logs rotator-apac-02` for `AssumeRole` errors. Also we should validate time skew on that node.
carla: found this in rotator logs:
```
2026-03-20T03:43:59Z rotator: WARN assume-role failed: ExpiredToken
2026-03-20T03:44:00Z rotator: INFO refreshing credentials
2026-03-20T03:44:02Z rotator: ERROR kms:Decrypt AccessDenied
```
sara: ExpiredToken on some pods. That aligns.
ben: action items I propose:
- replace legacy rotator on apac-proxy-02 with v1.9 canary image (quick rollout)
- add a targeted retry with increased backoff for KMS Decrypt failures
- surface STS expiration metrics to infra dash
sec-oncall: also we need audit & compliance artifacts: capture CloudTrail events for those AccessDenied, save them to ticket, and mark as incident-if-SLA-breached. Does this incident cross our mtls SLO? It's causing ~7% failure in that proxy pool.
sara: yes it's crossing error budget for apac staging mirror. We should promote a hotfix to production if we still see failures after canary.
carla: one more ask for config hardening: let's ensure TLS policy enforces minimum TLS1.3 and clamps allowed ciphers. Add a preflight check on the proxy that rejects clients with legacy ciphers and logs them to a separate index.
ben: agreed. Also double-check KMS key policy: we should prefer resource-based KMS grants for rotator (Grant tokens) so rolling role updates don't cause short window denies.
sec-oncall: filing a short postmortem checklist now. I'll collect:
- CloudTrail snippets (saved)
- rotator logs (saved)
- proxy logs (saved)
- STS token age histogram (dash)
- list of nodes using legacy rotator
sara: I'll kick the canary rollout: `kubectl set image ds/rotator apac=rotator:v1.9-canary -n infra` ; watching.
deploy-bot: deploy started by sara at 2026-03-20T04:01:05Z — canary -> 1/3 pods updated.
carla: after 45s, apac-proxy-02 rotated, I see no further `AccessDenied` entries; handshake error rate dropped to 0.8%.
ben: excellent. long-term: add STS refresh robustness, KMS grant strategy, and an on-node healthcheck that reports `rotator_credential_age_seconds` to infra.
sara: can we also schedule a config audit to ensure all regions use unified TLS profiles? Right now eu/prod is stricter than apac.
sec-oncall: yes, putting on backlog for next sprint and tagging product for SLA implications. I'll update the ticket with artifacts and mark status: mitigated, monitoring.
carla: thanks all. cc @compliance for audit trail link: https://internal.corp/audit/6789012345
sara: :thumbsup: end thread.
